subject: Installation of 65 New Bike Racks
overview: The commission discussed the planned installation of 65 new bike racks and established a photo collection project to document inadequate snow removal on state-controlled bike infrastructure. The body also formed a website working group and approved previous meeting minutes.

items.title: Bike Rack Planning and Installation
items.summary: The commission confirmed the city will install 65 new bike racks this year through grant funding and prioritized approximately 100 business district locations for placement. Emily O'Brien was designated as the point person for tracking installations and coordinating with city staff.

items.title: Snow Removal Advocacy and Infrastructure Maintenance
items.summary: Approved a motion to create a shared photo album documenting impassable bike and pedestrian infrastructure to support advocacy for better snow removal by state agencies like DCR and MassDOT. Members discussed the need for a more holistic approach to clearing corridors rather than relying on inconsistent neighbor efforts.

items.title: Mystic River Rotaries and Pump Track Updates
items.summary: Tabled the Mystic River Rotaries repainting project due to a lack of contact at the DCR and noted that a letter of support for a car park pump track had been successfully submitted.

items.title: Administrative Items and Working Groups
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting and created a working group consisting of Chris, Anna, and Bruce to update the commission's website. Discussion of a Bike Month working group was deferred to the next meeting.
